Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Artoo & •Threepio]]: R2-D2 sprays a cloud of smoke at the stormtroopers behind him while the heroes run for the ''Millennium Falcon'' during the escape from Cloud City in ''The Empire Strikes Back''.
